nodes.name: Build the summary and worklist
nodes.notes: Why Code: counts by status, outcome and reason with fixed plain-English wording, plus the worklist rows, from all of a batch's cases at once. The email holds counts only.

nodes.name: Done with this batch
nodes.notes: Every path ends here. Its output goes back to the Dispatcher, which moves on to the next batch.

nodes.name: Note: how to read this workflow

parameters.content:
## HARSLL – Dispatcher: report a batch
Called by the Dispatcher once for each spreadsheet whose summary has not been sent. Gets the batch and the settings.

- Reads the batch's cases. If any is unfinished, it stops here and the batch waits for a later run
- Otherwise it saves the staff worklist (when staff have cases to look at), sends the counts-only summary email, and marks the summary sent

## Report one batch
Counts-only summary email, plus a worklist spreadsheet when staff have cases to look at.
